about_the_game:
When distress strikes, in locations hard to reach, people will often depend on life saving helicopters. Join the helicopter rescue service and be part of the solution in this arcade style simulation game.

Take up the role of a helicopter pilot and fly your craft to its designated locations so help and service can be provided to those in need.

Experience the gameplay in these types of missions:

  • Search & Rescue

  • Natural disaster assistance and rescue

  • Medical evacuation

  • Firefighting

  • Express supplies deliveries

  • Heavy goods transport

Manage and improve your helicopter fleet by successfully completing missions at hand. 

The game features simple to use controls and a gameplay experience that is easy to learn.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 660 or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows OS compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or equivalent

short_description: In this arcade style simulation game, be the pilot of a life saving helicopter and a member of a life saving crew. Whenever lives are in danger you will make a difference by ensuring that the help is there.
